_asserts: 72% derives WARNING even though the server said `normal` — the percent floor (>= 70) applies independently of server severity.
91% derives CRITICAL by the > 90 rule, again overriding `normal`.
A `weekly_scoped` entry with a `warning` server severity keeps WARNING; server severity and the percent rule are OR'd, never AND'd.
A missing scope.model.display_name falls back to the literal "Model".
An empty-string severity is treated as absent (null), not as a value.
A null percent stays null and derives NORMAL — it must not become 0.0.
`spend: null` plus `extra_usage.monthly_limit: null` yields no credits.
